raw:
@q query
  select ?who
  where all
    match
      relation "transfer"
      role subject "the user's son"
      role source "Liceul Tehnologic din Pașcani"
      role destination "a high school in Iași"
      role time "during the semester"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "send"
      role subject ?who
      role object "the transcript"
      role destination "the new school"
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
